bc.interface: U,U',N,P continuous in the same x direction

marais.reconstruction: Replace the second cos by sin; replace q by q^2 inside the inner radical. Derived from H*r^4+(J*omega^2-EA)*r^2-m*omega^2=0; independent of printed frequencies.

popov.ratio_warning: Mode 11 is printed 10.998 and retained. Frequencies reconstructed as ratio*f1 are not raw measurements; unrounded measurements unavailable.
popov.speed_policy: Use printed c for every primary model; also report 2*L*f1. No E or rho invented; divide equation and energies by rho*A.
popov.eq5_mapping: A in f_wn is printed but undefined there; use c from (1),(3) and p273, not cross-sectional area F. Source lambda=omega/c.
reference_warnings_as_printed: p278: conditions (11) in six/seven significant digit closeness claim
popov.fig5: signed f_cal-f_exp, Hz; 30 positive modes, nu=0.31 and 0.34; free ends (10), stated p277

numerical_contract.popov_guard_note: Initial development search expected 30 and found 31 in both 810/1620 interval scans. Range unchanged; mode 31 retained only as an upper guard, 30 modes compared. No tolerance or physical input changed.
numerical_contract.recovery: At most one doubled scan if expected count or scaled residual gate fails; preserve both attempts. Otherwise stop unresolved.
numerical_contract.completeness: Marais analytic determinant argument count in f rectangle [1,31000]+/-25i Hz, 2048 then 4096 samples per horizontal edge; energy lower bound excludes [0,1]. Finite numerical count, not universal certification.
